metadata.title: fix(ui): hide selector container on zero search results in Virtual Server modals
metadata.author: shoummu1

description:
# Bug-fix PR

## :pushpin: Summary
In the Add Server and Edit Server modals, searching in any of the four selector panels (MCP Servers, Associated Tools, Associated Resources, Associated Prompts) with a query that matches nothing left an empty styled bordered box visible in the UI. This PR hides the container and shows a contextual "No X found containing `<query>`" message instead.

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3314

## :repeat: Reproduction Steps
1. Open the Add New Server or Edit modal for any Virtual Server
2. In any selector panel, type a search string that matches nothing (e.g. `z`)
3. Observe: empty bordered box remains above the "No X found" message

## 🐞 Root Cause
Multiple layered issues:

1. **`admin.js` — 6 server-side search functions** (`serverSideToolSearch`, `serverSidePromptSearch`, `serverSideResourceSearch`, and their Edit counterparts): zero-results branch cleared `container.innerHTML` but never set `container.style.display = "none"`, leaving the empty styled div visible.

2. **`admin.html` — missing HTML elements**: `noPromptsMessage`, `noResourcesMessage`, `noGatewayMessage`, and `noEditGatewayMessage` paragraphs were absent from the Add Server and Edit Server modals entirely, so no "no results" message could appear.

3. **`admin.js` — `applySearch()` in `initGatewaySelect`**: client-side gateway search hid individual items but never hid the container itself. The "no results" element IDs were hardcoded to Add Server elements, so the Edit Server modal was completely unaffected.

4. **Secondary regression from fix**: hiding a container on zero results, then changing the MCP Server selection (which triggers `reloadAssociatedItems()`), reloaded fresh content into the still-hidden container.

## :bulb: Fix Description

- Added `container.style.display = "none"` in the zero-results branch and `container.style.display = ""` at the start of all 6 server-side search functions to restore visibility on each new search.
- Moved `container.style.display` toggling outside the `if (noMsg)` guard in `applySearch()` so hiding is unconditional regardless of whether the message element exists.
- Made `applySearch()` dynamically resolve the correct message element IDs based on `selectId` (`"Edit"` → Edit modal elements, otherwise Add modal elements).
- Added the 4 missing `noXMessage` HTML elements to their respective modals in `admin.html`.
- After each `initToolSelect` / `initResourceSelect` / `initPromptSelect` call inside `reloadAssociatedItems()`, re-run the active search function so a previously-hidden container is correctly shown or re-filtered against the newly loaded content.

## :test_tube: Verification

| Check | Command | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Lint suite | `make lint` | |
| Unit tests | `make test` | |
| Coverage ≥ 90 % | `make coverage` | |
| Search returns zero results → box hidden | Manual (Add Server) | |
| Search returns zero results → box hidden | Manual (Edit Server) | |
| Clear search after no-results → box shows | Manual | |
| Change MCP Server with active search query | Manual | |

## :triangular_ruler: MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- [x] Matches current MCP spec
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## :white_check_mark: Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
